tools.title: Equal Groups Explorer
tools.description: Make equal groups or arrays to multiply, then share or group counters to divide. See multiplication, repeated addition and division equations side by side.
worksheet: Show 5 groups of 3. Write a multiplication equation.
Write 7 × 4 as repeated addition and find the product.
How many counters are in an array with 3 rows of 8?
Share 18 equally into 3 groups. How many are in each group?
Put 18 into groups of 3. How many groups?
6 groups (18 ÷ 3 = 6)
Find the unknown number: 4 × ? = 32
8, because 4 groups of 8 is 32 (32 ÷ 4 = 8)
Reflect: How are sharing and grouping different? How are they the same?
Sharing knows the number of groups and finds the size; grouping knows the size and finds the number of groups. Both are division.

tools.title: Break-Apart Arrays
tools.description: Split an array of unit squares into two smaller arrays to find hard facts from easier ones. Rotate the array to see the commutative property.
worksheet: Break 6 × 7 into 6 × 5 + 6 × 2. Find each part and the total.
Break 8 × 6 into two equal parts. Write the equation.
Use a 5s fact to find 4 × 9.
Rotate 7 × 4. What is 4 × 7?
28 — the same as 7 × 4
What is the area of a rectangle 3 units by 8 units?
24 square units
Fill in the blank: 9 × 6 = 9 × 5 + 9 × __
Reflect: Why does breaking an array apart give the same total?
No squares are added or taken away — the two smaller arrays still cover the whole array.

tools.title: Multiplication Table Patterns
tools.description: Explore the 10 × 10 multiplication table. Highlight a row, shade even products, find every way to make a product, and solve missing-factor puzzles.
worksheet: Use the table: 8 × 9 = __
Highlight the 5s. What digits do the products end in?
0 or 5
Find every way to make 24 in the table.
Why does the table look the same on both sides of the diagonal?
a × b = b × a, so each product appears in two matching places.
Shade the even products. Is 4 times any number even or odd? Why?
Even, because 4 × a number is double 2 × that number.
Reflect: How can a pattern help you remember a hard fact like 9 × 6?
For example, 9s products go up by 10 and down by 1 (54 is 60 − 6), and the digits add to 9.

tools.title: Rounding Number Line
tools.description: See any number from 0 to 999 between two tens or two hundreds, find the halfway point and round. Then estimate sums and differences.
worksheet: Round 63 to the nearest 10.
Round 85 to the nearest 10.
90 (85 is exactly halfway, so round up)
Round 449 to the nearest 100.
Round 650 to the nearest 100.
List all the whole numbers that round to 70 (nearest 10).
Estimate 278 + 419 to the nearest 100. Then find the exact sum.
Reflect: Why do we look at the halfway point when we round?
Numbers before halfway are closer to the lower ten or hundred; numbers at or after halfway round up.

tools.title: Fraction Bars and Number Lines
tools.description: Build a fraction from unit fractions on a bar and on a number line from 0 to 2. Turn on Compare to find equivalent fractions and compare fractions.
worksheet: Show 2/3. How many equal parts are in one whole? How many are colored?
3 equal parts; 2 are colored
Where is 1/4 on the number line from 0 to 1?
At the first mark after 0 when the space from 0 to 1 is cut into 4 equal parts
Find a fraction equal to 2/4.
Compare 2/6 and 5/6. Write >, = or <.
Compare 1/3 and 1/6. Write >, = or <.
1/3 > 1/6, because thirds are bigger parts than sixths
What whole number is 8/8? What whole number is 6/3?
Reflect: Why is 1/8 smaller than 1/4 even though 8 is bigger than 4?
The whole is cut into more parts, so each part is smaller.

tools.title: Clocks and Elapsed Time
tools.description: Set a start clock and an end clock to the nearest minute. A number-line timeline shows the jump to the next hour, whole hours and minutes, and the total elapsed time.
worksheet: A clock shows the hour hand just past 7 and the minute hand 3 marks past the 4. What time is it?
How much time passes from 3:10 to 3:55?
45 minutes
How much time passes from 8:40 to 9:15?
35 minutes (20 minutes to 9:00, then 15 more)
Recess starts at 1:25 and lasts 50 minutes. When does it end?
How long is it from 11:30 to 1:05?
1 hour 35 minutes
A movie ended at 4:00. It lasted 1 hour 20 minutes. When did it start?
Reflect: Why is it helpful to jump to the next hour first?
Whole hours are easy to count; the leftover minutes are added at the start and end.

tools.title: Scaled Graph Builder
tools.description: Show pet votes on a scaled picture graph (each face can stand for 2, 5 or 10) and on a bar graph that counts by 2s, 5s or 10s. Answer how many more and how many fewer.
worksheet: With a key of 2, how many faces show Fish (20 votes)?
10 faces
With a key of 5, how many faces show Fish?
4 faces
Dogs have 12 votes. Can a key of 5 show 12 with whole faces? Explain.
No. 12 is 2 faces (10) and part of a face for 2 more.
How many votes are there in all? (Dogs 12, Cats 8, Fish 20, Birds 6)
How many more votes does Fish have than Birds?
14 more
On a bar graph that counts by 5s, between which two numbers does the Dogs bar end?
Between 10 and 15 (at 12)
Reflect: When is a bigger key or scale helpful?
When the numbers are big, so the graph is not too long and is quicker to read.

tools.title: Area and Perimeter Grid
tools.description: Build rectangles on a grid or paint your own shapes from unit squares. Area and perimeter update as you go, so you can find shapes with the same area and different perimeters.
worksheet: What are the area and perimeter of a rectangle 6 units long and 4 units wide?
Area 24 square units; perimeter 20 units
Find two rectangles with an area of 18 square units.
For example 3 by 6 and 2 by 9 (also 1 by 18 on a big enough grid)
What is the perimeter of a 5 by 5 square?
20 units
Rectangles with perimeter 12 can be 1 by 5, 2 by 4 or 3 by 3. What is the area of each?
5, 8 and 9 square units
A rectangle has a perimeter of 14 units and a width of 3 units. How long is it?
Paint an L-shape made of a 4 by 2 rectangle and a 2 by 1 rectangle. What is its area?
10 square units (8 + 2)
Reflect: How are area and perimeter different?
Area counts the unit squares inside; perimeter measures the distance around the outside.
